name: Company News
description: Open, independent benchmark on company news APIs for AI agents - web search APIs vs dedicated news indexes on 300 company news questions, ranked by cost per 1,000 correct answers. Exa, Parallel, Perplexity, Brave, Firecrawl, Linkup, You, TinyFish, Tavily, Google SERP, Seltz, PredictLeads, Autobound, Datahyena.
